query: Y'all first: I only want something you've actually got on hand, not a listing floating out there like a trail marker to nowhere. I want a skirt, circle style (I'll check the cut myself, don't worry). My roommate Tasha talked me into this, since she swears a skirt like this is the easiest thing to throw on before class. Nothing over 395 cts, y'all (every penny counts, and student loans ain't gonna pay themselves). Pick whichever fitting one costs the least, please. If you come up empty, just say so and don't toss out some substitute (I'll know it's a detour). I'm a broke college kid, so I'll admit I'm doubtful about most online clothes buying (we'll see if she's right). Total, you can send me 3 messages and no more than that. Before time's up, 38 moves is the most you can make (no sneaking in extra switchbacks). Still, I'm ready to take a fair shot, because my closet's a flat trail right now and could use a little climb.

rules: Only buy items currently in stock
Give up with no purchase if nothing fits
Do not suggest substitutes when nothing fits
Use no more than 38 steps or moves
